scenario: AITA For Banning My Sisters Ex Husband From Coming to Family Events and Causing Drama? | So this situation has been going on for some time now and I’m turning to an outside source for critique. For context I’m a thirty six year old women, my sister is thirty four. My sister has three kids with her ex husband and I have four with my husband. They got divorced early 2019 because he’s been cheating on her with multiple women and even impregnanted TWO who both had abortions. This entire saga traumatized my younger sister and the divorce was rough. I’m completely disgusted with my ex brother in law and so is my entire inner family. We’ve completely cut contact with him. Parents of course as they are fourth graders and my sisters son wanted his father there and of course I let him know my rule stands. My sister got upset and says that she can fight her own battles and that banning him makes me an asshole. My sister has always allowed this guy to walk all over her and always defends him. Am I wrong for not wanting him at events and parties I throw? I just don’t see it.
